decisions.reason: Because this burner component disappeared from the website after 2023 and the firm is shifting its innovation story toward broader, lower-carbon system solutions rather than standalone burner parts, it should be discontinued as a separate market offering.

The electric infrared panel heater was shown only in 2023 and then removed, which suggests limited market traction and a weaker fit with the firm's core strength in customized large-scale heating systems.

The electric halogen infrared heater likewise vanished from the website after its launch year, indicating it did not become a durable part of the portfolio and is less differentiated than the firm's engineered hall and building-climate solutions.

The hydrogen-capable gas dark infrared heater should be kept because it moved from initial launch in 2023 to a dedicated 2024 presentation as an innovative breakthrough and directly supports the firm's strategic move toward hydrogen-ready, lower-carbon heating.
